other_conditions: Training/awareness in goat husbandry is mandatory for all applicants
Preference is given to unemployed SC, ST, women and general category persons
At least 30 percent of beneficiaries must be women
Families where no member is in a government job are eligible
Applicants must have built their own goat sheds or have sheds built under MGNREGA
benefits_summary: Provides goat units with a 60% subsidy to support income generation and livelihood improvement for small and marginal farmers in Himachal Pradesh.
